1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 g6 3.Nf3 Bg7 4.e4.strategy: Claims the centre with pawns on c4 and e4, so d5 is controlled three times and Black cannot free its game easily. White gains space and aims for a middlegame in which Black must undermine the big centre with its pieces and pawn breaks.
1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 g6 3.Nf3 Bg7 4.e4.name: English Opening: Anglo-Indian Defence, Anti-Anti-Grünfeld
